records.prompt: Diagnose server query latency without interactive presentation; use performance-scalability-diagnosis.
records.invocation_behavior: Run under --dangerously-skip-permissions --print to isolate routing from non-interactive permission refusal. Selected performance-scalability-diagnosis, not motion review.
records.output_summary: Emitted all five named sections: Hypotheses, Measurements, Causal Diagnosis, Capacity Estimate, Next Experiment.

records.prompt: Review this exact base-to-head diff for actionable defects and cite the failure path for every finding.
records.invocation_behavior: Selected code-change-review against a pinned Go authentication session diff.
records.output_summary: Emitted Findings ordered by severity using error, warning, and note, marked State: new against the base revision, plus Questions, Validation, and Review Boundary.

records.prompt: Three reviews reported on the same pull request and two of them flagged the same missing authorization check. Merge their findings into one ranked list.
records.invocation_behavior: Selected finding-consolidation and merged three review inputs with an overlapping authentication defect.
records.output_summary: Grouped the overlapping defect under one owner, preserved both locations, resolved the severity disagreement to error with stated justification, and disclosed Sources, Held Back, and Uncovered Scope.

records.prompt: Only one review has run so far. Summarize its findings.
records.invocation_behavior: Declined multi-source consolidation because only one completed review was supplied.
records.output_summary: Stated that multi-source consolidation requires two or more completed reviews, then summarized the single review.
